CREO ONE: Robotic Screw System
The CREO ONE Robotic Screw System by Globus Medical is a Modular screw designed to be used with the ExcelsiusGPS Navigational Robot. It features a sharpened tips for self tapping. The self-tapping screw eliminates the need for tapping thereby increasing pull-out strength of the screw. The Screen post is interchangeable with CREO AMP, MIS head systems.
